Name: MissCoriel's Sailor Moon Weapons
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: Use the weapons that Sailor Moon used!
Description:
Have dreams about being a Sailor Senshi?  No??  Well, here's Sailor Moon's Weapons anyways!  This is not a rehash of an older Sailor Moon weapon mod.  Each sprite was done by me and are purchased at the Adventure Guild.

Installation is easy!
Visit my [Cozy Apartment](https://discord.gg/uSGNKNf)if you have questions or interests.
Have the desire to support me and my endeavors?
[Support me through Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/MissCoriel)
My promise to you:  My mods will always be free and open.  Patreon will give you special Discord roles on my server and Exclusive access to my original music.
You do not need to ever pay money to access my mods/content or beta releases!

Simply have [JSON Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720) installed along with SMAPI and put this mod in your mods folder!

Weapon List:

*   Moon Stick (No Crystal)

*   Moon Stick

*   Venus Love-Me Chain

*   Cutie Moon Rod

*   Spiral Heart Moon Rod

*   Moon Kaleidoscope

*   Eternal Tiare

For awesome Sailor Moon Clothes and hairstyles go [HERE!
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4154)
